title: Croatian Pork Skewers
description: A delicious and flavorful dish featuring marinated pork skewers with a hint of Croatian spices, served with a side of crunchy vegetables.

ingredients.name: Croatian spice blend (paprika, garlic powder, salt, black pepper)
Crisp red bell pepper, cut into 1-inch pieces

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together Croatian spice blend and olive oil.
Add pork cubes to the spice mixture and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread marinated pork, bell pepper, and onion onto skewers.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until pork reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
Let skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with parsley and serve with lemon wedges.
